Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get ACME into the AWS co-sell motion alongside the marketplace listing:

- Objective: Get ACME’s pilot and subsequent production deployment listed on AWS Marketplace and enrolled in the ACE co-sell program.
- Immediate asks from ACME: procurement checklist, estimated contract value (pilot + 12mo forecast), and a primary contact for ACE registration.

Proposed immediate next steps (can we align on these today?):
1) You share the procurement spreadsheet (I attached a template) and candidate contract value.
2) We complete ACE registration (I’ll start the intake; you’ll get the AWS registration link to approve).
3) Intro to AWS PDM/PSM (Raj) — we’ll request a short triage call to align roles and success criteria.
4) Draft a mutual action plan (MAP) for target milestones: ACE registration, marketplace listing, pilot launch, go-to-market co-sell readiness.

I’ve attached our quick intake form that mirrors the AWS ACE fields; filling that out will accelerate registration. I’ll also loop in our marketplace lead (Karthik) and partner ops (Hannah) to coordinate the MAP and any technical artifacts AWS will need.

Available windows for a 30-min sync: Mon/Tue 9–11 PT or Wed 1–3 PT — tell me what works and I’ll send an invite.

Thanks — excited to get this moving.

—
